definition.title: H-R Diagram Explorer
learning_objectives: Explain that an H-R diagram relates stellar temperature and luminosity and conventionally places hotter stars on the left and cooler stars on the right.
Recognize broad stellar-population structure without treating plotted regions as deterministic classification rules.
Compare the physical H-R representation of Gaia effective temperature and FLAME luminosity with the Gaia BP-RP and absolute-G colour–magnitude representation.
Understand that the physical H-R and Gaia colour–magnitude views use related but different source-published quantities and are not interchangeable coordinate labels.
Inspect source-published asymmetric uncertainty intervals and source-provided spectral class, FLAME stage group, and cluster membership without inventing classifications from plot position.
Understand that the four equalized cluster samples illustrate related stellar populations but are not a complete astrophysical survey.
definition.uncertainty_semantics: For Gaia teff_gspphot, lum_flame, and mg_gspphot, lower/central/upper are the source-published 16th/50th/84th percentiles. Lumina preserves asymmetric intervals and does not call them symmetric ±1-sigma errors. BP-RP uncertainty is not synthesized.

x.label: Effective temperature, T_eff
x.direction: 50000 K hotter at left; 2500 K cooler at right.

x.label: Gaia BP−RP colour
x.direction: bluer/smaller values at left; redder/larger values at right.

y.label: Gaia absolute G magnitude, M_G
y.direction: −5 mag at top; +15 mag at bottom; smaller magnitudes are intrinsically brighter.

filters.combination: OR within one dimension; AND across spectral class, stage group, and cluster dimensions. An empty array means zero records for that dimension.

stage_groups.label: Main sequence
stage_groups.meaning: Lumina grouping of the source-published FLAME stage index; not a plot-position classifier.

stage_groups.label: Turn-off / pre-RGB transition
stage_groups.meaning: Lumina grouping between Gaia/FLAME turn-off and base-RGB landmarks; not an observed morphology label.

stage_groups.label: Red giant branch
stage_groups.meaning: Lumina grouping of the source-published FLAME stage index; not a plot-position classifier.

selection_method.algorithm: Within each non-empty cell, sort by numeric Gaia DR3 source_id ascending; iterate non-empty cells in stage then spectral order and select one unselected row per round until 32 records are selected.
selection_method.eligibility: All required Gaia fields finite and ordered; spectral class O/B/A/F/G/K/M; flags_esphs second digit 1–4 (Gaia primary class probability >0.5); FLAME stage and all four display quantities inside the frozen domains.

relationships: The plotted central values are source-published Gaia DR3 quantities; Lumina does not derive temperature, colour, luminosity, or absolute magnitude from another field.
The stage_group is a deterministic grouping of Gaia FLAME evolstage_flame at the frozen boundaries 100, 360, 490, and 1290.
The physical-HR and CMD coordinate maps are disclosed logarithmic or linear visualization transforms only.

equations.physical_luminosity_y_fraction: u_L = (log10(L) − log10(1e−3)) / (log10(1e5) − log10(1e−3)); screen y inverts u_L

calculation_module.valid_domain: Fixed artifact rows only: T_eff 2500–50000 K, luminosity 1e−3–1e5 L☉, BP−RP −0.5–4.0 mag, and M_G −5–15 mag; source intervals must be ordered and finite.
calculation_module.numerical_policy: Source values retain artifact precision; no scientific conversion is performed. Python validation uses finite double-precision checks and browser coordinate transforms reject non-finite/out-of-domain values.

output_schema: curated source-backed records with Gaia DR3 identity and membership provenance
physical H-R central values and asymmetric source percentile intervals
Gaia BP-RP and absolute G magnitude central values with M_G percentile intervals
source spectral class, raw flags, raw FLAME stage, and Lumina stage group
cluster membership and optional extinction/reddening context
selected-star detail and active-filter table result
definition.visualization_module: Native SVG plots source-backed rows with disclosed axis transforms; selected uncertainty is rendered for the focused star. Semantic table content is authoritative and complete for the active filters; markers, symbol choices, minimum sizes, and screen coordinates are presentation behavior.
assumptions: Gaia DR3 source-published values are used as delivered; Lumina does not reproduce Gaia inference models.
The H-R and CMD views are alternate source-variable views and are not connected by a Lumina temperature-colour or luminosity-magnitude conversion.
FLAME evolutionary-stage groups are model-derived educational groupings, not direct observations or universal morphology classifiers.
BP-RP is plotted as observed Gaia colour and is not dereddened by Lumina; extinction/reddening can shift it.
The four-cluster sample is intentionally equalized to 32 records per cluster and has no population-density meaning.
limitations: This is a fixed curated Gaia DR3 educational sample, not a complete, volume-complete, magnitude-complete, IMF-representative, or cluster-complete survey.
Only Pleiades, Hyades, Praesepe, and M 67 are represented; marker density must not be read as cluster population density.
Gaia T_eff, M_G, luminosity, spectral tags, and FLAME values are data products with source model assumptions; lum_flame and evolstage_flame are inferred/model-derived quantities.
O/B/A/F/G/K/M are broad Gaia source tags, not full MK classifications or luminosity classes.
A star’s plotted position does not determine its spectral class, evolutionary stage, age, mass, radius, lifetime, or future evolution.
No evolutionary tracks, isochrones, bolometric conversion, colour-temperature conversion, or magnitude-luminosity conversion is shown.
